p1.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-new-york-casino-diversity-framework-current-and-planned-diversity-efforts-mwbe-contracts
p1.excerpt: Drawing from our successful approach to construction workforce diversity in other markets such as Chicago where we have exceeded our stated goals, we have established clear diversity targets for our contractors and subcontractors that align with our overall project goals: 40% minority workers, 10% women workers and 10% veteran workers.

p2.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evaldiv6.ballys.mwbeconstructiongoals_redacted.pdf
p2.excerpt: The following table illustrates the significant workforce diversity targets for the Bally’s Bronx construction project. We will create 15,000 union construction jobs, including 6,000 (40% utilization) minority workers, 1,500 women workers (10%) and 1,500 veteran workers (10%).

p3.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/03/12.01.25.gflbselectiondocument1.pdf
p3.excerpt: In the construction phase, Bally’s seeks to achieve a workforce drawn primarily from the Bronx and made up of approximately 10 percent women, 10 percent service-disabled veterans, and 40 percent minority construction workers.

p4.title: https://casinos.ballys.com/chicago/faq.htm
p4.excerpt: Bally’s Chicago has set a 46% MBE/WBE construction goal, exceeding city requirements.

p5.title: https://casinos.ballys.com/chicago/about-ballys.htm
p5.excerpt: And, we have met with nonprofit groups to discuss workforce development initiatives to help us meet our women, minority, veteran, and persons with disability hiring goals by reaching out to and recruiting Chicagoans who are seeking careers and job growth in this dynamic industry.

p6.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evalwork4.ballys.mwbe_redacted.pdf
p6.excerpt: In addition to our business enterprise goals, we are establishing the following workforce diversity targets for the estimated 15,000 construction jobs that will be created:
